name: How do I choose the right contractor for my residential remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my residential remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, verify their licensing, general liability insurance, Better Business Bureau accreditation, and hands-on presence on the job site. Inquire whether the contractor relies entirely on disconnected third-party crews or provides direct oversight. HH Remodeling LLC is a BBB Accredited Business with an A+ rating where owner Abraham Becerra serves as both principal contact and on-site lead. Having an owner-operator who personally manages framing, finish carpentry, and trade coordination ensures clear daily communication, accountable craftsmanship, and fair, transparent pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for proven credentials, BBB accreditation, verified insurance, transparent pricing, and a contractor who provides direct, on-site supervision throughout the job.
